info.name: TrellisKit API
info.description:
REST API for the TrellisKit engine: Phase 0 platform routes, Phase 1 identity and membership, the property routes, and the Phase 2 routes (media, feed posts, public feed, comments, reactions, reports, moderation, admin feed, moderators, blocks, word filter, member search, link previews, notifications, push tokens, email unsubscribe, account export jobs, labels and tags). Also the Phase 3 forums (forums, threads, polls, search, public threads, forum admin and moderation), live updates and app configuration (manifest, update publishing, keys and channels, flags and kill switches), and AI models and assistants (endpoints, assistants and knowledge, member and visitor chat, analytics). Brand, membership product, and profile taxonomy come from the active property (GET /api/v1/property); examples use the sample property samples/example. See REST_API.md for full contracts and docs/ENUMERATION_AND_METADATA.md for the binding list rules.

Enumeration: every list has a POST <collection>/enumerate request (EnumerationQuery body: maxResults, continuationToken, skip, ordering, search, createdAfterUtc, createdBeforeUtc, labels, labelMatch, tags, filters) and a GET <collection> request with the same fields as query parameters (labels repeatable, tag.<key>=<value>, collection filters as top-level parameters). Both return EnumerationResult { success, maxResults, skip, continuationToken, endOfResults, totalRecords, recordsRemaining, timestampUtc, objects }. Every object carries labels and tags.

Variables:
- baseUrl: server origin, default http://127.0.0.1:8000 (use http://127.0.0.1:8080 to go through the website's nginx proxy).
- adminToken: break-glass admin bearer token. The local Docker stack uses the value in the mounted property server/settings.json.
- client: X-Client header value (mobile returns the refresh token in the body; web uses the tk_refresh cookie).
- memberEmail / memberPassword: credentials used by Register and Login.
- accessToken / refreshToken / userId: set by Register, Login, sign-in, and Refresh.
- verifyToken / resetToken / unsubscribeToken: paste from the emails in Mailpit (http://127.0.0.1:8025).
- memberId, compId, subscriptionId, signupCodeId, signupCode, redemptionId, avatarFile: set by the matching list and create requests, or paste.
- mediaId, mediaUploadUrl, mediaFile, mediaCookie: set by the media upload and grant requests.
- notificationId, exportId, exportDownloadPath, wordFilterTermId, blockUserId, pushToken: set by the matching requests, or paste.
- feedPostId, scheduledPostId, deletePostId, publishAtUtc, publicFeedPostId, commentId, replyCommentId, commentCursor, reportId, moderationActionId: set by the feed, comment, report, and moderation requests.
- reactionKey (default like) and moderatorUserId: a reaction key from the property and a member to grant FeedModerator.
- fromUtc / toUtc: time window for request history summaries and enumeration windows.
- requestHistoryId: set automatically by the request history enumeration.

Member routes use the accessToken variable; admin routes use adminToken (a SystemAdmin access token also works). All application routes live under /api/v1. Errors use { error, message, fieldErrors }. Every 429 carries Retry-After. Typed collection filters (for example depth, childLimit, key, state, publishedAfterUtc) work as GET parameters or in the POST filters object. Also the Phase 4 library, events, and directory (with engagement on those types) and the Phase 5 direct messages, realtime, support, ideas, and broadcasts.
